PortfolioProject.title: PortfolioProject
PortfolioProject.description: A creative digital agency project uploaded by the admin for public showcase on the Portfolio page.

category.description: Service or industry category for the project.

liveUrl.description: Live public website URL for the project.

description.description: Concise overview of the delivered project.

challenge.description: Key business or UX challenge faced in the project.

approach.description: Design and engineering approach taken to solve the challenge.

thumbnailUrl.description: Project thumbnail image URL or compressed inline data URI for live preview cards.

published.description: Whether the project is publicly visible on the Portfolio page.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who created the project.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was last updated.

AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Authorized admin role mapping for Winner Designs portfolio management.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin user.

email.description: Verified email address of the admin user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

/projects/{projectId}.description: Portfolio projects managed in the Admin Dashboard and displayed publicly when published.

/admins/{userId}.description: Admin role records used for Firestore security authorization.
